howItWorks.heading: Company details
howItWorks.description: Add your business name, tagline, description, and logo — this appears at the very top of your website.

howItWorks.heading: What you offer
howItWorks.description: List your services or products, with pricing, descriptions, and links, so customers know exactly what you do.

howItWorks.heading: Gallery
howItWorks.description: Add photos of your work, space, or products — pick the ones that show your business at its best.

howItWorks.heading: Contact details
howItWorks.description: Add your phone, email, and address so customers know how to reach you.

howItWorks.heading: Inquiries & reviews
howItWorks.description: Connect a free Web3Forms account to collect inquiries and reviews straight from your site.

howItWorks.heading: Follow
howItWorks.description: Add your social links — Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and more — so visitors can follow you.

howItWorks.heading: Appointment
howItWorks.description: Take bookings? Add your Calendly link and keep it in sync — customers can book straight from your site.

howItWorks.heading: Choose your template
howItWorks.description: Pick a template, colors, a background image, and its transparency and opacity, to match your brand.

howItWorks.heading: Preview
howItWorks.description: See exactly how your site will look on desktop and mobile. Nothing goes live until you're happy with it.

howItWorks.heading: Go live
howItWorks.description: Publish your site to your own address, like yourbusiness.gudispace.com — included, at no extra charge.

howItWorks.heading: Your free trial
howItWorks.description: Your site is free for {{TRIAL_DAYS}} days. Add a plan any time from Manage Plan to keep it live permanently — cancel whenever you like.

faq.question: Can I preview my website before publishing?
faq.answer: Yes. Preview works directly in your browser for desktop and mobile layouts.

faq.question: Can I update my website later?
faq.answer: Yes. Use Manage website with your account email to load and modify it.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything?
faq.answer: No installation is needed when GudiSpace is hosted online.

faq.question: Do I need any design or coding experience?
faq.answer: No. Add your business details in a simple form, then choose a template — GudiSpace builds the site for you. No design or coding skills needed.

faq.question: How do I log in to manage my website?
faq.answer: There's no account or password to remember. Use Manage website with the email you signed up with, and we'll send a one-time code to confirm it's you.

faq.question: How long does it take for my website to go live?
faq.answer: Usually under a minute or two after you confirm the code. If it doesn't load right away, wait a moment and refresh.

faq.question: What address will my website have?
faq.answer: Your own address, like yourbusiness.gudispace.com — included at no extra charge.

faq.question: Can I collect inquiries or reviews from visitors?
faq.answer: Yes. Connect a free Web3Forms account, and messages and reviews submitted on your site are sent straight to you. You can then review them and decide whether to add them to your website — so a stranger can't spam it with bad reviews and hurt your business.

faq.question: Can customers book appointments through my website?
faq.answer: Yes, if your business takes bookings. Add your Calendly link and it stays in sync automatically.

faq.question: How many photos can I add to my gallery?
faq.answer: Up to 8 when you first create your site, and up to 24 once you're editing it through Manage website.

faq.question: Can two websites use the same email or company name?
faq.answer: No. Each email can have one active website, and company names must be unique, so we'll let you know if either is already taken.

faq.question: What happens if I delete my website?
faq.answer: It's removed permanently and can't be undone, so make sure before you confirm.

faq.question: How much does GudiSpace cost?
faq.answer: Your site is free to try for {{TRIAL_DAYS}} days. After that, add a plan from Manage Plan to keep it live — see current monthly and yearly pricing there.

faq.question: What happens when my free trial ends?
faq.answer: If you haven't added a plan, your site is removed after {{TRIAL_DAYS}} days. We'll email you a reminder before that happens, so there's time to add a plan and keep it live.

faq.question: Can I cancel my plan?
faq.answer: Yes, any time from Manage Plan. Your site stays live until the end of the period you've already paid for.
